He looked up across the gray, empty expanse of the Atlantic, watching the lantern above begin its slow evening turn against the falling gloom.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡，路灯在薄雾中泛着昏黄的光晕。街道空旷而寂静，偶尔驶过一辆环卫车，刷刷的扫地声回荡在水泥楼宇之间。几家早点铺悄悄亮起了微弱的灯火，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白汽，伴随着冷冽的晨风消散在天际，默默等待着第一批赶路的人。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a rule solves a puzzle by telling you to solve a smaller piece of the exact same puzzle first.\n- Think of opening a Russian nesting doll: you open one doll to find another doll inside, repeating until you hit the tiny solid doll at the center.\n- That tiny solid doll is the stopping point, which lets you finish what you started and put the whole set back together."}
